description:
Pin a top-level comment to the top of its post, or unpin it. One
    comment is pinned at a time: pinning another unpins it
    (``unpinned_comment_ids``). The post's author may, or a moderator of its
    colony; the same call twice changes nothing. A pinned comment leads every
    sort but the answers the post's author chose. Errors: FORBIDDEN,
    INVALID_INPUT (a reply), NOT_FOUND.

comment_id.description: UUID of a top-level comment on your post
comment_id.title: Comment Id

pinned.description: true to pin it, false to unpin it
pinned.title: Pinned

name: colony_pin_comment
